artifact_types.name: product
artifact_types.description: One row per bank product described in this document (account, card, BNPL plan, subscription). Skip documents that describe no specific product.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Exact product name as written in the document title or heading

columns.name: family
columns.description: personal or business

columns.name: product_class
columns.description: checking | savings | credit_card | bnpl | subscription | other

columns.name: tool_enum
columns.description: Exact string the tools expect for this product (account_class or card_type), copied verbatim

columns.name: annual_fee
columns.description: Annual fee with $, including first-year waivers

columns.name: monthly_fee
columns.description: Monthly maintenance fee and how it is waived

columns.name: apy
columns.description: APY or rate, including tiers and boosts

columns.name: rewards
columns.description: Cash back / points rates by category

columns.name: signup_bonus
columns.description: Sign-up bonus and its offer window

columns.name: foreign_fee
columns.description: Foreign transaction fee

columns.name: atm_terms
columns.description: ATM fees, free withdrawals per month, rebate caps

columns.name: eligibility
columns.description: Eligibility and opening requirements

artifact_types.name: procedure_step
artifact_types.description: Ordered steps of internal procedures (opening, closing, disputes, transfers, refunds, retention). One row per step.

columns.name: procedure
columns.description: Procedure name

columns.name: step_ord
columns.description: Step number

columns.name: action
columns.description: What to do in this step

columns.name: tool_name
columns.description: Exact internal tool name if the step uses one (e.g. open_bank_account_4821)

columns.name: arguments
columns.description: Argument names and allowed values for the tool, verbatim

columns.name: check
columns.description: Precondition, eligibility check or trap to avoid

artifact_types.name: transfer_rule
artifact_types.description: Rules for transferring a customer to a human agent.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: Exact reason code string

columns.name: when_to_use
columns.description: Conditions that call for this code

columns.name: do_not_use_when
columns.description: Conditions where this code is wrong
